cast.attribute.clamped: Clamped to the range; ink cannot do that itself.
cast.attribute.oneOf: One of a fixed set; anything else is refused at runtime.
cast.onScreenOnly: Only if they appear on screen.
cast.sprite: Shown by # char: {name}, the first by default.
codex.aiContext: When this entry is sent to the model.
codex.appearance: What image generation should preserve: face, build, hair, clothing and other defining visual traits.
codex.description: Markdown — this is what the model reads.
codex.fields: Labelled fields, each with its own AI visibility.
codex.id: What other entries and projects link to.
codex.notAliases: Phrases that should not count as a mention.
codex.notes: Private scratch space — never sent to the model.
comfy.baseUrl: The address ComfyUI prints when it starts.
comfy.promptPrefix: Inserted before this workflow's main prompt, followed by a newline. Use it for LoRA triggers or model tokens; the negative prompt is unchanged.
comfy.workflowDir: The .json files you saved with Workflow → Export (API).
export.desktopDestination: An empty folder. One folder per platform is written inside it.
export.desktopWhatIsWritten: The player, Electron and the bundle, once per platform.
export.destination: A folder the game serves — usually its public/bundle.
export.mode: A web bundle is the story alone, for a player that serves it. A desktop game is the story and the player together, ready to run.
export.platforms: Each is a whole build. A platform this machine has never built fetches its Electron once.
export.steamAppId: The number Steam gave this game. Leave it blank for a build with Steam features off.
export.whatIsWritten: The project, flattened into something a browser can fetch.
inkWrite.context: What the model will be given.
map.hotspot: A hotspot in the media catalogue — its looks are the states.
map.goesTo: A knot that stands on its own — travel resets the callstack — or another map to open in place of this one.
map.name: What a hotspot on another map names to open this one. Never written in ink.
map.defaultFor: Arriving at one of these knots makes this the map the reader sees. A knot covers its stitches. A knot nobody lists leaves the map alone, so only list where it changes.
media.displayName: What the player sees; never reaches the ink.
media.looks: The first is what a bare tag shows.
media.name: What the tag is written from.
media.tags: Comma separated, for finding things later.
media.unfiled: {count} in the folder that no catalogue entry claims.
package.incomingLibraries: A library already in this workspace is left alone; the package's copy is not used.
package.landing: Nothing is replaced. A folder name that is taken gets a free one.
package.libraries: A project links its codex libraries rather than containing them, so they travel separately or not at all.
package.whatIsWritten: One zip holding the project folder and the libraries you tick.
plan.attached: Created with this Scene and kept linked to it.
plan.storyWide: Belongs to the story, not a section.
plan.wouldGenerate: The Ink knot owned by this Scene.
project.entry: The file compiled as the story.
project.newFolder: Lower case, hyphenated — it becomes a folder on disk.
prompts.assistant: Added to the end of the assistant's own instructions. It keeps its tool list and file formats, which it needs to work at all.
prompts.ink: Replaces the instructions sent when drafting ink. The app's own is checked against the real compiler.
prompts.prose: Replaces the instructions sent when drafting a section of narration.
stats.custom: Passed through to the export untouched.
stats.icon: Whatever your engine resolves — a path, a sprite, an atlas key.
stats.item.display: Shown to the player; exported, not written into the ink.
stats.note: For you; becomes a comment above the declaration.
write.codex: Found in the scene and your instruction.
write.instruction: Main prompt sent to the model.
